# Raw Sync — reconcile manifest with filesystem

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- Write a file to create manifest ---
stdin ../csv-input.txt
exec akb raw write test.csv
stdout 'Written to raw/test.csv'

# --- Verify manifest exists ---
exists raw/files.log

# --- Write another file externally (simulates external addition) ---
exec bash -c 'echo "external" > raw/external.txt'

# --- Run sync to detect new file ---
exec akb raw sync
stdout 'Synced: 1 new, 0 modified, 0 deleted, 1 unchanged'

# --- Verify external file is now in manifest ---
exec akb raw list
stdout 'external.txt'
stdout 'test.csv'

# --- Modify a file externally ---
exec bash -c 'echo "modified content" > raw/test.csv'

# --- Run sync to detect modification ---
exec akb raw sync
stdout 'Synced: 0 new, 1 modified, 0 deleted, 1 unchanged'

# --- Delete a file externally ---
exec bash -c 'rm raw/test.csv'

# --- Run sync to detect deletion ---
exec akb raw sync
stdout 'Synced: 0 new, 0 modified, 1 deleted, 1 unchanged'

# --- Verify test.csv is removed from manifest ---
exec akb raw list
! stdout 'test.csv'

# --- Run sync on clean state (no changes) ---
exec akb raw sync
stdout 'No changes to sync.'

# --- Test --no-commit flag ---
# Write a file but don't commit
exec bash -c 'echo "nocommittest" > raw/nocommittest.txt'
exec akb raw sync --no-commit
stdout 'Synced: 1 new, 0 modified, 0 deleted, 1 unchanged'

# Verify files.log was updated but no commit was made
! exec bash -c 'git diff --cached raw/files.log | grep -q "nocommittest.txt" && exit 0 || exit 1'

-- csv-input.txt --
hello world

-- csv-modified.txt --
hello modified
